_doc: Per-kingdom structure rules for kingdoms whose higher taxonomy the GBIF
Backbone does not describe the way this tree does. Read by
docs/bacteria-and-viruses.md. A kingdom not listed here is scaffolded
from the GBIF Backbone as before.
authority: the dataset a new family and every rank above it must be
found in (accepted, non-synonym, exact name). The family node records
it as scaffoldedFrom, so each placement can be checked against it.
ranks: the levels between KINGDOM and FAMILY, top first. Other ranks
the authority has (NCBI's clades and kingdom, ICTV's sub-ranks) are
createTopRank: false means a family whose top rank is not already in
the tree is refused and reported, not scaffolded -- a new phylum or
realm is a structure decision, not a data one.
unassigned: where a family the authority places under no rank in
`ranks` goes. 'kingdom' puts it directly under the KINGDOM node (ICTV's
rejectNames: a family or rank name matching any pattern is refused,
with the reason in the report.

rejectNames.why: placeholder with a numeric id (bin or clone name)
